Definition: from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G5316 (compare G1810) (meaning non-apparent); unexpected, i.e. (adverbially) suddenly:--sudden, unawares.
BiblicalUsage: Twice, and both times it is a warning. Jesus says that day will come unawares on the careless, like a snare; Paul says that when people are saying Peace and safety, then sudden destruction comes upon them, like labour pains on a woman with child.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for suddenness carries little theology on its own; its weight is the warning in both verses, that the day finds the careless asleep.
RelatedTopics: Second Coming; Day of the Lord; Urgency
